title: Putnami Site Content Bundle Manifest
description: Closed manifest shape for site-content-bundle/v1: a digest-addressed tar.gz payload mounted into a Putnami site URL tree. Adding any manifest field requires a format-major bump.

formatVersion.description: Bundle format version. Consumers ignore bundles with a newer major.

mounts.description: Site URL prefixes owned by this bundle. Overlap is invalid and enforced by protocol helpers.

files.description: Every regular file in the tar.gz payload.

urlPrefix.description: Absolute normalized site URL path prefix. Root '/' and trailing slashes are not valid bundle mounts.

commit.description: Whitespace-free source commit or immutable ref.

path.description: Payload-relative forward-slash path. It must fall under a declared mount when served at '/' + path.

digest.description: sha256 digest as 64 lowercase hex characters.
